about_the_game:
The Hero Tale is an action-adventure RPG set in a vibrant medieval fantasy world, developed as a university final project. Inspired by games like The Legend of Zelda, Skyrim, Fable, Dragon’s Dogma, and other genre-defining classics, it invites you on a memorable heroic quest.

You play as The Hero, a young lumberjack whose peaceful life is shattered when he returns to find his village in ruins, destroyed by a dark force threatening to consume the entire world. Driven by loss and vengeance, he embarks on a journey that follows the 12 stages of Joseph Campbell’s legendary “Hero’s Journey.”

Explore The World, a colorful realm inspired by Norse and Celtic cultures. Uncover ancient secrets, face mythical creatures, and bring peace to scattered lands. Only you can rise to become the hero fate demands—before darkness claims it all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or Intel Core i5-10400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card compatible with DirectX 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 de 64 bits or higher
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 7845HX or Intel Core i7-12700H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 or AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card compatible with DirectX 12
